706720101.text: Wait, isn't that Tubby? What's she doing in The Cat's Tail!?

706720105.text: What are you doing here? ...Wait, and how'd you get out of the Serenitea Pot? You can do that?

706720106.text: Of course I can... Ah, but this is your first time seeing me outside of the teapot realm, isn't it?

706720107.text: Although the adepti created teapot spirits primarily to manage and maintain their teapot realms, our movements are not restricted to those domains.

706720108.text: For instance, there's Chubby— I'm sorry, "Jade Seeker," who travels far and wide to gather the rarest treasures in the land.

706720109.text: *sigh* But it is true that I, in contrast, rarely leave the teapot realm at all.

706720111.text: Huh, well since you so rarely leave, what's the occasion today?

706720113.text: As curious as I am to know how the drinks here differ from those in Liyue, no — in fact, I was sent here for a reason.

706720117.text: #Um... and as it happens, it has something to do with {NICKNAME}, too.

706720119.text: Well, as I'm sure you've discovered, with the rising popularity of Genius Invokation TCG, inviting a friend to a duel in the tavern has become a fun way to pass the time.

706720120.text: There's just one little problem. Many invitees currently have to travel an enormous distance to get here, turning the whole thing into quite an ordeal. I have therefore been sent here to create a little game room using the same adeptus art as is used to construct teapot realms.

706720121.text: That way, anyone with an invitation will need only to think the thought, and they will instantly appear in the game room.

706720122.text: You will be free to use the room whenever you wish to invite a friend to duel, and it will be far more straightforward for them to take you up on the offer.

706720123.text: Wow. This'll make things much easier!

706720124.text: But... What if Margaret finds out? She's not gonna get mad at you for renovating her tavern with your adeptus arts, is she...?

706720125.text: Umm... That shouldn't be a problem, since the realm will not be physically located within The Cat's Tail. Besides, we obviously sought the owner's permission in advance...

706720126.text: She was quite enthusiastic: "Ooh, Liyue's adepti arts sound pretty useful! Could you double the size of the tavern while you're at it?" ...Unfortunately, my mastery of adeptus arts is not sufficient to achieve this.

706720127.text: Huh... Yeah, that does sound like something Margaret would say...

706720128.text: Anyway, it's great that you're here — I was expecting to have to wait until your next visit to the teapot realm to fill you in.

706720131.text: #Over to you, {NICKNAME}. Now you can invite friends to duel with you in this room, wherever in the world they are. I hope it serves you well.

706720132.text: ...Oh, and I almost forgot. A guy from the tavern wanted me to say this to you:

706720133.text: Hope you'll have fun playing Genius Invokation TCG!

706720116.text: Indeed not, although it may surprise you to learn that the reason I was sent here still has to do with the card game.

706720134.text: Tubby uses her adeptus arts to remodel the tavern and update the match invitation board.

706720201.text: Huh? There's a strange new customer in the tavern!

706720204.text: Excuse me, I am not a finch! My name is...

706720205.text: Um... Oh dear, it seems... No, I can't quite remember my name. You can just call me "Tubby," I suppose.

706720206.text: Well, hey Tubby. Don't think we've seen you around Mondstadt before...

706720207.text: That's because it's highly unusual for me to be in Mondstadt at all. I actually came here all the way from Liyue...

706720208.text: So... How come you came all this way just to visit The Cat's Tail?
